visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a clean, light grey gradient background that features a subtle, multi-faceted crystal or diamond-like graphic shimmering in the center. At the top center, the logo and company name '達特仕保養品 DRX Series Skincare' are displayed in a professional black font. Below this, a large header in bold Traditional Chinese characters appears, introducing the topic of ingredient mixing. (2) Centered on the screen, three horizontal rows of graphic elements are presented. Each row features two ingredient representations, such as a drop of yellow liquid or a smear of white cream, separated by a plus symbol. An equals sign follows, pointing to a skin-toned circle. Text labels explain that these combinations result in 'even skin tone,' 'pore clearing,' and 'whitening.' The layout is balanced and uses minimalist iconography. (3) The final scene shifts to a bright white background decorated with elegant, sweeping grey diagonal lines that suggest movement and cleanliness. The 'DRX Series Skincare' logo and brand name are enlarged and repositioned to the center of the frame, serving as a concluding brand identification shot. The lighting is uniform and bright throughout the entire animation.
